intro.title: New beginnings, in balance with nature
intro.body1: ZAMÄ BACALAR is an eco-conscious, sustainable residential community of residential lots and Boutique Villas. Named after the Mayan word for sunrise, it stands for new beginnings, balance, and a way of living where architecture follows the landscape.
intro.body2: Every space is designed to preserve the spirit of the place through bioclimatic design, local materials, native plants, and responsible planning.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.p1: {developer}, developer of {name}, is responsible for the personal data you share with us through this website.
privacy.p2: Your name, phone number, email, and any message you send through our contact, quote, or partner forms. We also record the referring page and campaign parameters (UTM) to understand how you found us.
privacy.p3: We use your data to contact you, send you the information you requested, follow up with you as a prospective buyer or partner, and improve our communication. We do not sell or share your data with third parties outside the sale of this development.
privacy.p4: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, object to its use, or withdraw your consent by messaging us on WhatsApp at {whatsapp}.
privacy.p5: Any changes to this notice will be posted on this page.
